info.title: Campaign Forge API
info.description: Multi-agent marketing workflows over HTTP. Send `X-API-Key` on every `/api/v1` request. Runs execute in the background: start one, then poll its execution.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. Needs no key.

schema.title: Response List Agents Api V1 Agents Get

post.description: Start a campaign (a built-in workflow on a brief). Poll the returned execution.

schema.title: Response List Workflows Api V1 Workflows Get

post.description: Store a custom workflow for this key, validated against the agent registry.

schema.title: Response List Executions Api V1 Executions Get

post.description: Continue a paused, failed or interrupted run from its checkpoint.
Approve (or reject, which cancels the run) a step waiting for a human.

get.description: Supported providers. Keys appear only as configured or not.

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Providers Get

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description:
A declarative predicate on an input or step artifact. It is never ``eval``-ed.

``path`` is a dotted path into the artifact's JSON data. String comparisons
for ``contains`` are case-insensitive. A missing artifact or path counts as
"not present".
